g.text: DECK_ID for DECK-PAD: 33k / 3.3k -> 3.3*3.3/36.3 = 0.30 V (spec/20-electronics.md 6.2: 0.30 V +-0.15 V)

g.desc: DECK_ID for DECK-PAD: 33k / 3.3k -> 3.3*3.3/36.3 = 0.30 V (spec/20-electronics.md 6.2: 0.30 V +-0.15 V)

g.text: FSR pads (option): FSR1..FSR16 -> U2 I0..I15, FSR17/FSR18 -> U3 I0/I1.

g.desc: FSR pads (option): FSR1..FSR16 -> U2 I0..I15, FSR17/FSR18 -> U3 I0/I1.

g.text: SL1/SL2 = 30 mm slide pots (10k) across 3V3, wipers on the ribbon; the 1k/100n RC is on PANEL-1 before the MCP3208 CH0/CH1.

g.desc: SL1/SL2 = 30 mm slide pots (10k) across 3V3, wipers on the ribbon; the 1k/100n RC is on PANEL-1 before the MCP3208 CH0/CH1.

g.text: PAD1..PAD18 matrix 3 rows x 6 columns (ROW1..3 = MCP23017 GPA0..GPA2 driven low, COL1..6 = GPB0..GPB5 read with external 10k pull-up R21..R26). Panel coordinates in matrix-tables.md.

g.desc: PAD1..PAD18 matrix 3 rows x 6 columns (ROW1..3 = MCP23017 GPA0..GPA2 driven low, COL1..6 = GPB0..GPB5 read with external 10k pull-up R21..R26). Panel coordinates in matrix-tables.md.

g.text: 18 tactile 12x12x5 + 18x WS2812B-2020 + 2x 30 mm fader (10k, 3V3) + MCP23017 (0x20, matrix 3x6) + 2x 74HC4067 (FSR option) + IDC-16

g.desc: 18 tactile 12x12x5 + 18x WS2812B-2020 + 2x 30 mm fader (10k, 3V3) + MCP23017 (0x20, matrix 3x6) + 2x 74HC4067 (FSR option) + IDC-16

g.text: DECK-PAD Bukifon v1.0 290 x 78 x 1.6 mm (spec/10-panel-ui.md 3.1, spec/20-electronics.md 6.3) CERN-OHL-S-2.0

g.desc: DECK-PAD Bukifon v1.0 290 x 78 x 1.6 mm (spec/10-panel-ui.md 3.1, spec/20-electronics.md 6.3) CERN-OHL-S-2.0

g.text: 18 x WS2812B-2020 in one chain after LED_IN from PANEL-1, powered from +5V (J-DECK pin 16), 100n per LED. Last DOUT = no connect. Brightness is limited by firmware (total 9+18 or 9+42 LEDs).

g.desc: 18 x WS2812B-2020 in one chain after LED_IN from PANEL-1, powered from +5V (J-DECK pin 16), 100n per LED. Last DOUT = no connect. Brightness is limited by firmware (total 9+18 or 9+42 LEDs).

g.text: FSR option: 18 x 2-pin pad (film lead) + 10k pull-up to 3V3, one node per mux channel; channel select S0..S3 = MCP23017 GPA3..GPA6, enable = GPB6/GPB7. When the FSR film is not fitted the channel reads full scale (3V3) - normal.

g.desc: FSR option: 18 x 2-pin pad (film lead) + 10k pull-up to 3V3, one node per mux channel; channel select S0..S3 = MCP23017 GPA3..GPA6, enable = GPB6/GPB7. When the FSR film is not fitted the channel reads full scale (3V3) - normal.
